title: Response cache
subtitle: The gateway answers identical non-streaming chat requests from the same key with a stored response for the configured time. Provider prompt caching is separate and not configured here.
ttlHint: 0 turns the cache off. Clients skip the cache with the x-hub-bypass-cache header or "cache": false.

store.title: Storage and lifetime
store.description: Responses are stored per key, model, and request body. Hits are free for the key and logged as response cache hits.
store.backend: {backend, select, redis {Redis, shared} memory {In memory} other {Redis unreachable}}
store.backendHint: {backend, select, redis {All app instances share the response cache, and it survives restarts. Responses stay in Redis until they expire.} memory {Each app process keeps its own response cache, which is emptied on restart. Set REDIS_URL to share it.} other {REDIS_URL is set, but Redis does not answer. Each app process uses its own memory cache until Redis is back.}}

semantic.title: Semantic matching
semantic.description: Answers a request from the response cache when only the last user message differs and means nearly the same. System prompt, earlier messages, model, and parameters must still match exactly.
semantic.enabledHint: {ready, select, true {Every cache miss first embeds the last user message. That adds latency and embedding cost.} other {Choose an embedding model first.}}
semantic.modelHint: Embeddings run on this alias with the calling key's routing rules and are billed to that key. Keys that may not use this model only get exact matches.
semantic.thresholdHint: Minimum cosine similarity. Lower values answer more requests but can return an answer to a different question.

stats.title: Response cache statistics
stats.hint: Counts requests that were eligible for the response cache, across all keys. Net savings are the cost of the original responses served again from the response cache, minus the embedding cost of semantic lookups. Provider prompt caching is not included.
